name: Summer Playground Program
operator_name: City of Pittsfield Parks and Recreation
description_short: Free supervised summer program for Pittsfield children ages 6 to 13 at Clapp Park, Durant Park and The Common. Playground leaders run sports, games, crafts and nature activities, with free lunch and snacks every day.
notes: Free. No pre registration; a form is filled out on the child's first day. Runs at Clapp Park, Durant Park and The Common; moves to the Berkshire Family YMCA, 292 North Street, in bad weather.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026: July 6 to August 14, 9:30 am to 3:30 pm, Monday to Friday, at Clapp Park, Durant Park and The Common; free; open to Pittsfield children ages 6 to 13. No pre registration; parents fill out a form on the first day. Free lunch and snacks from Pittsfield Public Schools. In bad weather the program moves to the Berkshire Family YMCA, 292 North Street.

for_andrew: Open only to Pittsfield children, and it is a free drop in program with no registration ahead of time, not a camp with enrollment. List it?
It runs at three parks and the page gives no street address, so there is no ZIP and the draft fails validation.
